description: This file implements a client for MCP (Mesh Configuration Protocol) communication, supporting both stdio-based and HTTP-based interactions. It handles discovering capabilities like tools and resources from MCP servers, initializing connections, and optionally starting temporary MCP server instances programmatically.

classes.name: MCPProtocolClient
classes.description: Client handling MCP protocol communications via stdio or HTTP, capable of discovering tools and resources, and managing MCP server processes.

methods.name: NewMCPProtocolClient
methods.description: Creates a new MCP protocol client instance with specified verbosity.

methods.name: DiscoverCapabilitiesFromProcess
methods.description: Discovers MCP capabilities from a running process, either via stdio or HTTP, depending on process configuration.

methods.name: DiscoverCapabilitiesFromURL
methods.description: Discovers MCP capabilities from a remote server specified by URL.

methods.name: StartMCPServerForDiscovery
methods.description: Starts an MCP server process temporarily for capability discovery, based on a command template and environment variables.
